notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Dockside Extortionist, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping those, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.
